ratings_risks.title: Requirements split below the quotation and notice threshold
ratings_risks.risk: Related payments to one supplier may together reach a threshold that each single payment stays under, so the quotation and Portal requirements of [rule:CPR-43] may not have been applied, contrary to the anti-splitting rule [rule:CPR-08].

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement.windows}} supplier windows in general procurement combine to reach the threshold within {{$.tests.split_purchases.parameters.window_days}} days [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement]. Counts are lower bounds because payments at or below the publication floor are not published. No adverse past audit on this theme, so no uplift.

impact.justification: The flagged windows total {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement.gbp}} in the period [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement.gbp].

evidence: Placements shown separately: {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.placement_separately.windows}} windows, exempt from competition under [rule:CPR-53].
Windows may reflect legitimate recurring services; each is an indicator to test, not a finding.
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Test the largest general-procurement windows for a single underlying requirement and for the quotation evidence required by [rule:CPR-43].

ratings_risks.title: Payments clustered just below the quotation threshold
ratings_risks.risk: A concentration of single payments just under the threshold may indicate values being kept below the point at which [rule:CPR-43] applies.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_threshold.25000.below_band_by_tag.general_procurement.count}} general-procurement payments sit in the band just below the threshold [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_threshold.25000.below_band_by_tag.general_procurement], against {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_threshold.25000.above_band_comparator.count}} in the comparator band just above it across all spend [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_threshold.25000.above_band_comparator]. No adverse past audit on this theme, so no uplift. Auditor amendment (comment of 2026-10-19): likelihood lowered because the below-band count is not higher than the count just above the threshold, so the data shows no clustering below the threshold; kept in scope as a targeted test of the payments in the band.

evidence: Below-band payments across all spend tags: {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_threshold.25000.below_band.count}}; the statutory-threshold tiers were not tested: {{$.skipped[0].reason|raw}}
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Review the quotation evidence for the largest payments in the band and whether they relate to a larger requirement.

ratings_risks.title: High-value suppliers with no contract notice found
ratings_risks.risk: Suppliers whose annualised spend reaches the publication threshold may have no matching published contract notice, so competition and publication under [rule:CPR-43], [rule:CPR-46] and [rule:CPR-06] may not have been followed, or the contract may sit outside the notice export.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.suppliers}} general-procurement suppliers at or above the threshold have no matching active notice [metric:$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement]. The notice export is not a contract register, so many may hold unpublished or older contracts [metric:$.contracts].

impact.justification: The annualised estimate for these suppliers is {{$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.annualised_estimate_gbp}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.annualised_estimate_gbp]; seasonal or one-off spend distorts annualisation.

evidence: Exact notice matches: {{$.tests.off_contract.per_match_class.exact.suppliers}} suppliers; near-name candidates: {{$.tests.off_contract.per_match_class.near_ratio.suppliers}} by ratio and {{$.tests.off_contract.per_match_class.near_contain.suppliers}} by containment, for the auditor to confirm.

Care and education placements ({{$.tests.off_contract.unmatched_by_dominant_tag.care_or_education_placement.suppliers}} unmatched suppliers) are excluded from the count; they are exempt under [rule:CPR-53].
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Obtain the contract file or exception record for the largest unmatched general-procurement suppliers and confirm the route to market.

ratings_risks.title: Spend continuing after matched contract notices ended
ratings_risks.risk: Payments may continue after the only matching contract notice ended without the S151 Officer approval of an extension required by [rule:CPR-50]; a newer contract may exist without a notice.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.by_dominant_tag.general_procurement}} general-procurement suppliers were paid in the window with every matched notice ended [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.by_dominant_tag]. Extension approvals are not visible in public data. No adverse past audit on this theme, so no uplift.

impact.justification: The annualised estimate for these suppliers is {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.annualised_estimate_gbp}} [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.annualised_estimate_gbp].

evidence: Of these, {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.at_or_above_publication_threshold.suppliers}} are at or above the publication threshold.
Notices hold dates only; extension options are not in the export, so some may be approved extensions.
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Request extension approvals under [rule:CPR-50] or the replacement contract for each supplier.

ratings_risks.title: Spend running above the annual rate of the award
ratings_risks.risk: Annualised payments above the award's annual rate may indicate scope or value growth without the variation approvals of [rule:CPR-51] and [rule:CPR-52].

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged_ratio_ge_threshold}} of {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.eligible_suppliers}} eligible suppliers exceed the flag ratio of {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.parameters.ratio_flag}} [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.parameters]. Variation approvals are not visible in public data. No adverse past audit on this theme, so no uplift.

evidence: Awarded values may be estimates or maxima and periods may include extensions, so a high ratio is an indicator only.
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Compare payments with the contract value and obtain variation approvals for the flagged suppliers.

ratings_risks.title: Same supplier, same amount paid more than once within a short period
ratings_risks.risk: Repeat payments of an identical amount to one supplier within a short period may indicate duplicate payment, and purchase evidence required by [rule:CPR-23] may not support each payment.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.duplicates.tiers.different_time.by_dominant_tag.general_procurement.groups}} general-procurement groups were paid at different timestamps within {{$.tests.duplicates.parameters.days}} days [metric:$.tests.duplicates.tiers.different_time.by_dominant_tag]. A past Accounts Payable audit gave a non-adverse opinion [history:AUD-15], so no uplift. No rule specifically requires duplicate-payment checks; the rating rests on the metric.

impact.justification: Amounts beyond the first payment total {{$.tests.duplicates.tiers.different_time.by_dominant_tag.general_procurement.gbp_beyond_first}} [metric:$.tests.duplicates.tiers.different_time.by_dominant_tag].

evidence: Same-timestamp batch groups (general procurement): {{$.tests.duplicates.tiers.same_timestamp.by_dominant_tag.general_procurement.groups}}, a lower-signal tier.
Recurring charges of equal value are common; counts are lower bounds.
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Trace the largest groups to invoices and confirm each payment was for a separate supply.

ratings_risks.title: Waivers, exceptions and award approvals not evidenced
ratings_risks.risk: Exceptions to the Rules and contract awards may lack the written approvals required by [rule:CPR-14], [rule:CPR-19] and [rule:CPR-39]. Public spend data cannot show approvals or waivers.

likelihood.justification: No public-data test can observe waivers or award approvals, so this is rated on the rule [rule:CPR-14] and the data gap, not on a count. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. The notice export records publication only, not approvals [metric:$.contracts]; history.json lists no agreed actions on this control, so L5 is not met.

impact.justification: Table 1 compliance descriptor for this score: 'Reasonable possibility of successful legal challenge. Reasonable possibility of regulatory interest.' Awards without the approvals of [rule:CPR-39] could attract challenge [history:THM-04].

evidence: Contract notices in the export: {{$.contracts.rows_for_council|int}}, which is a publication record, not an approvals record.
ratings_risks.proposed_focus: Request the exception register and award decision records and test a sample against [rule:CPR-19] and [rule:CPR-39].
